motions.motion: Board Member Clark moved that the Board of Canvassers verify the results of the election by ratifying the results of the canvass; accept the report of the Election Official and certify the election results; and declare City Council candidates Brett Wright, Rich Wood, Donna Rivera Burnham, and Jason Allen eligible to be on the ballot and nominated for the General Municipal Election on November 2, 2021. Board Member Love seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Donna Burnham, Melissa Clark, Colby Curtis, and Carolyn Love. The motion passed with a unanimous vote. 8.
